results.question: Find the most significant mill
results.sql:
SELECT m.*
FROM mill m
JOIN architect_mill_stats ams ON m.architect_id = ams.architect_id
WHERE ams.earliest_built_year = (SELECT MIN(earliest_built_year) FROM architect_mill_stats)
   OR ams.latest_built_year = (SELECT MAX(latest_built_year) FROM architect_mill_stats)
   OR ams.avg_built_year = (SELECT MAX(avg_built_year) FROM architect_mill_stats)
   OR ams.mill_count = (SELECT MAX(mill_count) FROM architect_mill_stats);

ambiguities.assumption_made: The generated SQL interprets 'most significant' as being related to the earliest built year, latest built year, average built year, or the number of mills associated with an architect.
ambiguities.plausible_alternative: Significance could also refer to mills with unique features, historical importance, or other attributes not represented in the database.
ambiguities.evidence_from_sql: The SQL selects mills based on the earliest built year, latest built year, highest average built year, or maximum mill count.

results.question: List architects who designed bridges in Utah and mills in Coswarem

SELECT DISTINCT a.id, a.name
FROM architect a
JOIN bridge b ON a.id = b.architect_id
JOIN mill m ON a.id = m.architect_id
WHERE b.location LIKE '%Utah%' AND m.location = 'Coswarem';

results.question: Show modern mills
results.sql:

FROM mill m
JOIN architect_mill_stats ams ON m.architect_id = ams.architect_id
WHERE m.built_year > 1900;

results.question: Find all structures in Utah
results.sql:
SELECT "bridge"."name" AS "Bridge Name", "location", "length_meters", "length_feet"
FROM "bridge"
WHERE "location" LIKE '%Utah%'
UNION
SELECT "mill"."name" AS "Mill Name", "location", NULL AS "length_meters", NULL AS "length_feet"
FROM "mill"
WHERE "location" LIKE '%Utah%';

results.question: Show architects who built every bridge in China
results.sql:
SELECT a.id, a.name
FROM architect a
JOIN bridge b ON a.id = b.architect_id
GROUP BY a.id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN b.location LIKE '%China%' THEN b.id END) = 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bridge WHERE location LIKE '%China%');

results.question: Show the top 3 longest bridges
results.sql:

FROM bridge
ORDER BY length_meters DESC
LIMIT 3;
